subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible history, and through what supported boundary?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested mirror path, but the plausible implementation choices involve third-party persistence ownership, direct DB/schema coupling versus an API or plugin boundary, opt-in configuration, and historical backfill policy.

options.title: Design opt-in sync
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with live Docker/OpenWebUI proof before implementation.

options.title: Move behind plugin or adapter
options.body: Keep core lean by requiring this Open WebUI-specific mirror to live behind a plugin or integration boundary, adding only a missing core seam if needed.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw owns transcript/model context only for this workflow and document that Open WebUI visible history is not updated by Control UI sends.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in sync
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with live Docker/OpenWebUI proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway chat/session history makes this the best available routing owner for the product and persistence-boundary decision.
